description_en: Grants a user group permissions on databases and database accounts
description_zh: 为用户组授权数据库及数据库账户
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost attach-database-accounts-to-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-zvp282aly06 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id 2 --databases '[{"DatabaseId":"58","DatabaseAccountIds":["1"]}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachDatabaseAccountsToUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user group to which you want to grant permissions
parameters.name: user_group_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the database instance to authorize
fields.help_zh: 要授权的数据库实例 ID
fields.name: database_id

fields.help_en: The array of database account IDs
fields.name: database_account_ids

parameters.help_en:
The array of database objects.
A maximum of 10 databases and 10 database accounts are supported. You can leave the database accounts unspecified. If no accounts are specified, permissions are granted at the database level
parameters.help_zh:
数据库对象数组。
最大数据库数10个，数据库账号数10个。允许不传账号，不传账号则代表授权到数据库
parameters.name: databases
